prompt: Why does the woman want to keep the upload time in the data?
promptZh: 女方為何要保留資料中的上傳時間？

options.text: It is the only time that should appear on the revised chart.
options.zh: 那是修正版圖表唯一應顯示的時間。
options.whyZh: 修正版要改用量測欄，不是繼續使用上傳欄。

options.text: It can help the team investigate delays.
options.whyZh: 女方同意圖表用量測時間，但指出保留上傳時間有助於查明延遲。

options.text: It tells them when the technician started the measurement.
options.zh: 可得知技術人員何時開始量測。
options.whyZh: 上傳時間記的是資料到資料夾的時點，不是操作人員開始量測的時點。

options.text: It gives them the time when the worksheet was printed.
options.zh: 可得知工作表何時列印。
options.whyZh: 對話中上傳與列印無關，未提到紙本時間。

explanationZh: 女方同意圖表用量測時間，但指出保留上傳時間有助於查明延遲。
evidence: Before you change anything, check the column headings. Four twenty is the measurement time. Four thirty-eight is when the reading was uploaded to the shared folder. The chart is using the upload column. / So we should keep both values in the data and point the chart at the measurement column? / Exactly. The upload time is useful when we investigate delays. Save a new chart and compare its first two points with the worksheet before sending it out.
